name: Shimla
description: Shimla is a historic blend of colonial Neo-Gothic architecture and quintessential Himachali hospitality perched on the Shivalik ridges.
history: Originally a small forest village named after Goddess Shyamala, Shimla rose to prominence in 1864 when it was declared the Summer Capital of British India. For over 80 years, it was the administrative heart of the Indian empire. The Kalka-Shimla Railway, completed in 1903 with 103 tunnels, is now a UNESCO World Heritage site. Post-independence, it became the capital of Himachal Pradesh. Its architecture, featuring the Viceregal Lodge and Gothic churches, remains a unique colonial heritage in the Himalayas.
culture: Shimla's culture is a sophisticated blend of colonial elegance and deep-rooted mountain traditions. The Ridge and Mall Road are the social heart of the city. Festivals like the 'Lavi Fair' (dating back over 300 years) at nearby Rampur showcase its trade heritage. The people are known for their distinct woolen attire, 'Siddu' culinary specialties, and a rich history of theater and arts, with the Gaiety Theatre being a historic landmark.

topSpots.name: Kufri
topSpots.description: A small hill station known for its trekking and hiking trails, and beautiful scenery.

topSpots.name: Viceregal Lodge
topSpots.description: Formerly the residence of the British Viceroy of India, now a premier research institute.

cuisine.name: Red Rice & Sidu
cuisine.description: A combination of nutrient-rich Himalayan red rice and steamed walnut-stuffed buns.
cuisine.history: Red rice has been harvested in the Shimla hills for centuries, prized for its earthy flavor and medicinal properties.
cuisine.tip: Enjoy it with fresh apricot chutney found in the upper Shimla regions.

wildlife.name: Cheer Pheasant
wildlife.description: A shy, long-tailed pheasant found in the steep grassy hills of the Shimla wildlife sanctuaries.

weather.packing_essentials: Light woolens for summer, heavy jackets and thermals for winter

festivals.name: Shimla Summer Festival
festivals.description: A colorful celebration of local culture, music, and food.

festivals.name: Ice Skating Carnival
festivals.description: Celebrating the winter spirit at South Asia's only natural ice skating rink.

itineraries.title: The Colonial Quintessential
itineraries.description: A perfect introduction to Shimla's heritage and mountain magic.

days.title: Colonial Footprints
days.description: Arrive and settle into the colonial vibe. Visit the grand Viceregal Lodge, the State Museum for local heritage, and end your day on The Ridge with a sunset view.

days.title: Kufri High Peaks
days.description: Drive out to Kufri for breathtaking nature views and yak rides. Return to Shimla to hike (or take the ropeway) to Jakhu Temple, the highest point in town.

days.title: The Mall Experience
days.description: Spend your final day shopping for local handicrafts at Lakkar Bazaar and enjoying high tea at one of the legendary Mall Road cafes.

itineraries.title: The Full Ridge Escape
itineraries.description: Explore beyond the city to the pristine valleys and heritage forest trails.
